subject: none

pattern: draw {n:Qty} card[s] , then put {m:Qty} card[s] from your hand on the bottom of your library
subject: none

examples.text: When ~ enters, draw four cards, then put three cards from your hand on the bottom of your library.
When ~ enters, draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on the bottom of your library.

counterExamples: When ~ enters, draw two cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library.
